Profile
Marvell Technology, Inc. is an American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology. Founded in 1995, the company had close to 7,500 employees as of 2026, with over 10,000 patents worldwide, and an annual revenue of $8.2 billion for fiscal 2026. Wikipedia
